title: Payload Time-Travel Inspector — stepwise failed-request playback & remediation UX
creator: Claire Huang
description: Design and prototype a 'Payload Time-Travel Inspector' for the Redwood Console that lets engineers examine a failed request across its lifecycle. The inspector surfaces a compact timeline of retries, model fallbacks, KV cache hits/misses, token deltas, and per-step cost estimates. It must support: stepwise playback of request attempts, a time-seek scrubber to jump to specific micro-steps, side-by-side payload diffs for retries, error taxonomy tagging with suggested runbooks, and an overlay showing which rollout/model variant served each attempt.
acceptance_criteria: UX shows a compact timeline with labelled attempts and latency/cost badges for each attempt
Clicking an attempt opens a stepper view: headers, request body, model variant, kernel profile, KV cache snapshot and token delta
Payload diff highlights character-level changes between attempts and allows copying of a chosen attempt to create a new replay
An error taxonomy chipset classifies the top-level failure (model-timeout, infra-throttle, invalid-input, auth) with suggested remediation links
The time-seek scrubber replays token-by-token generation (streamed when available) without blocking the console
Per-request cost estimate shown and summed across retries; cost geometry suggests likely optimizations
Design includes fallback state when payloads are redacted for privacy and clear CTA to request expanded logs (audit-controlled)
Prototype built in Figma and validated in two usability sessions with infra and platform engineers
design_decisions: Prefer a horizontal compact timeline (attempts left-to-right) to maximize width for payload diffs
Use on-demand payload hydration to avoid loading large payloads by default; hydrate when user clicks an attempt
Render token-level replay using a synthetic streaming layer to avoid depending on live model state
Show cost and latency badges inline to surface cost/impact without opening detail panels
Map error taxonomy to existing incident tags in observability backend to avoid duplicating labels
Keep primary inspector read-only; add an explicit 'Create Replay' CTA that opens a separate replay composer
